title: treesight session
description: One session as the page draws it: metadata read by script, plus the nodes and the still open items rebuilt from the ledger with the user's own edits applied.

title.description: The user's own name for the session, else the automatic title.

custom_title.description: True when the title is the user's own name.

summary.description: One sentence for the project view (its session overview), written by a treesight run: from the whole session when it was drawn, else from a short excerpt of it (the latest summary in the ledger).

summarizing.description: True while a run that is going on is writing this session's overview (it has none yet).

generated.description: Whether the tree has been extracted at least once.

gone.description: True when Claude Code has deleted the session's transcript; the session is drawn from what the ledger kept.

through.description: The last message the ledger has extracted.

last_run.description: What the latest extraction of this session added and closed, for the line under the title.

flagged.description: Open items it left for the user to confirm: an unsure close, or no longer possible.

by.description: Who added it: the model, with message id and quote, or the user by hand, without a quote (reserved: no command adds items yet).

state.description: open; confirm: the model thinks it is done but is not sure; stale: the model thinks it can no longer be done.
